note: City of Fort Scott campground in Gunn Park: ten gravel RV sites in the trees on the east side of the park's lake, with a tent area between them and the water. Porta-potties; pads are not level. Water is shut off in the winter, at the campsites too. --Claude

WATERFRONT lead (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 'not waterfront' kept, but there is a lake right beside the campground, not just the Marmaton River (which is ~280 m west, behind woods). On NAIP the gravel camping area at the pin runs along the east side of the park's west lake (~300 x 90 m, roughly 6-7 acres by my estimate from the frame - over the 5-acre pond line), with the gravel pads 20-60 m from the shore behind a band of trees; a reviewer (via a search summary) says the tent area lies 'between the RV sites and the lake', so not on-water. A filtered LAKEVIEW is possible from some pads, but I couldn't see it confirmed in any official photo, so I left it at 'not waterfront'.

RATING: RV Life 5.8/10 from 9 reviews (search summary); reviewers describe unlevel gravel pads ('Sites are not level and need either more gravel or concrete'). Local campground, so the private under-4 rule doesn't apply; reported only.
PIN 37.82695,-94.72390 sits on the gravel camping area east of the lake; fine. Google's 37.82936,-94.72474 is the park centre ~270 m NNW.
